name: DesignApp sources
description: The Design app (vector and UI design): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/DesignApp, built from SuiteUI's EditorShell: the window and its intents (DesignWindow, DesignIntent), the top bar, the tool rail, the canvas with selection handles (drawn above the page clip) and the inline text editor, the Properties | Layers panel (a List of the pages and the layer tree, and the inspector's Align row in DesignAlignBar), the File, Edit, Page, Object (Align) and View menus, and the open and save panels.
